stories.title: OpenAI pauses Astra over critical cyber capabilities
stories.blurb: OpenAI says it has paused internal activities around Astra, a model in development, because it isn't confident about the model's cyber capabilities. A lab stopping its own release is the sharpest version of the pacing debate so far.

sources.name: The Verge
sources.headline: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful

stories.title: Meta returns with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, open source
stories.blurb: A new open multimodal model built to run locally and act agentically. Local and open keeps shifting what a studio can do without sending the work to someone else's server.

sources.name: Hugging Face
sources.headline: Meta is back with Muse Glimmer: local, agentic, multimodal, and open source

stories.title: Distillation gets cheap enough to run at scale
stories.blurb: Making knowledge distillation cheap enough for routine use is how capable small models keep arriving. Worth watching if you weigh a small local model against a frontier API.

sources.name: Hugging Face
sources.headline: Making Knowledge Distillation Cheap Enough to Run at Scale

stories.title: Peer review is overwhelmed
stories.blurb: As research output and AI-assisted papers surge, volunteer reviewers can't keep up. A preview of what happens to any gatekeeping process once producing the thing becomes nearly free.

sources.name: Ars Technica
sources.headline: Peer review is overwhelmed—can it survive in the AI era?
